personas.label: Software
personas.title: Software Engineer
personas.intro: I build fast, concurrent backend services — Go, Python and well-tuned databases — and ship them in containers.
about: I'm a backend and distributed systems engineer with core expertise in Go concurrency, socket programming and low-latency database architecture.

I've shipped production services ranging from a high-concurrency forum to a three-tier search engine that falls through SQLite FTS5, live web sources and an LLM. I care about engineering standards: Docker workflows, GitHub Flow code review, and mentoring the people around me.
Away from the terminal I design, produce music, customise Linux workstations and play basketball.
